name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a decentralized social network made of independently operated, interoperable servers. People and organizations join a chosen instance to publish short posts, follow accounts, and participate across the federated network.
agentUseSummary: Connect one local account on a verified public instance, then let agents read bounded own activity, draft text, and publish one approval-controlled public or unlisted status without exposing tokens or arbitrary instance APIs.

capabilities.label: Read account
capabilities.description: Read the exact OAuth-bound local account on one verified public Mastodon instance.

capabilities.label: Read own statuses
capabilities.description: List at most ten recent own statuses, excluding replies and boosts.

capabilities.label: Publish text statuses
capabilities.description: Draft and publish one bounded public or unlisted text status.

allowed.label: Read connected account
allowed.description: Read the exact OAuth-bound local account on the verified instance.

allowed.label: List own statuses
allowed.description: List at most ten recent own statuses, excluding replies and boosts.

allowed.label: Draft text status
allowed.description: Prepare one bounded public or unlisted text status locally.

approvalRequired.label: Publish text status
approvalRequired.description: Publish one exact approval-controlled public or unlisted text status with an idempotency key.

blocked.label: Block broader social actions
blocked.description: Timelines, discovery, other accounts, replies, quotes, direct posts, boosts, favourites, follows, blocks, reports, notifications, media, polls, edits, deletion, scheduling, streaming, and moderation are not registered.

blocked.label: Block raw and unverified access
blocked.description: Private-network origins, redirects, arbitrary endpoints, pagination, bulk work, automatic retry, and raw ActivityPub or Mastodon API access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Account reads, bounded own-status reads, and local drafts run automatically; exact text publishing requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected Mastodon actions run without Relay per-action approval; exact instance/account authority, bounds, idempotency, audits, and secret isolation still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four typed Mastodon wrappers and attaches the encrypted token only inside Railway's verified, DNS-pinned per-instance adapter.
Relay mounts four typed Mastodon wrappers and attaches the encrypted token only inside Railway's verified, DNS-pinned per-instance adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: The sharded worker may not deploy Railway or run live provider consent; staging deployment and representative-instance OAuth acceptance remain for the integration and provider-console tasks.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, deploy only Railway staging, then use the separate provider-console task to connect representative public instances and validate dynamic registration, PKCE consent, exact account binding, bounded reads, exact approved publishing, idempotency, revocation, SSRF denial, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Mastodon documents per-server app registration, authorization-code token acquisition, token use, and revocation.
The apps API documents dynamic confidential-client registration, redirect URIs, scopes, client identifiers, and client secrets.
The accounts API documents exact credential verification and bounded account-status reads with reply and reblog exclusions.
The statuses API documents text publishing, public and unlisted visibility, language, and Idempotency-Key support.
Mastodon documents per-account and per-IP request limits, supporting Relay's bounded no-retry contract.
